name: Ful Medames
description: Simmered fava beans seasoned with cumin, lemon, and olive oil, a protein-rich Moroccan morning staple.
ingredients: a handful of fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Gather and prep the flatbread and white fish fillets, measuring everything out so it is ready to go.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat until warm but not smoking.
Add the sliced shallots and butternut squash, cooking gently until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the white fish fillets, season with ground cinnamon, and cook until just done, about 30 mins.
Warm the flatbread alongside, turning once, until heated through and lightly toasted.
Plate the flatbread and spoon the cooked mixture over the top.
tips: A squeeze of citrus or a sprinkle of parsley just before serving brightens up the whole plate.
Keep the heat moderate so the white fish fillets cooks through gently without drying out or turning rubbery.
